reproduction.rationale: The original PhysioP300 endpoint retains all four EEGPT/BENDR/BIOT/LaBraM rows, BAC/kappa/AUROC mean and reported SD, nine nominal LOSO subjects and three repetitions. Exact authentic cohort/event support remains unresolved: the converter excludes subject 1, the probe names nine subjects, the provider describes ten people, and epoch windows and possible recording overwrite require reconciliation. Native epoch/fold-to-report reduction, checkpoint selection, metric dependency and classification-threshold conventions, per-finding tolerances and uncertainty remain unresolved. The original four-method reproduction panel has 108 subject/repetition/method cells; the accepted arithmetic scorer requires 135 cells including a candidate, so no implicit duplication or fifth original method supplies a submitted-analysis interface. Immutable common inputs, cohort/split/panel/observation identities, runnable AI analysis and independent granular prediction/output verification are absent. No authenticated paper+data versus paper+data+author-code pairing establishes author code as the only information difference, exact code/checkpoint exposure, access policy or cumulative budgets. Source-table recovery and generated arithmetic controls do not establish AI execution, reproduction or condition availability.

Immutable common data/cohort/split/panel/observation identities, a runnable submitted-analysis interface, source-qualified evaluation and independent verification of granular predictions and full controls are missing.
